items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair: replace passenger airbag inflator
items.note: Free at a Lexus dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Retractable hardtop stops partway or won't close
items.job: Diagnose roof system; adjust or replace roof hinge or switch
items.note: A hinge adjustment or single switch is the cheap end. Owners report dealer hinge replacements around $3,500 and worst-case roof repair quotes of $5,000-$10,000.

items.t: Run-flat tires wear out fast and ride harshly
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,900 for tire replacement. Regular non-run-flat tires usually cost less.

items.t: Car pulls to one side or won't hold an alignment
items.note: RepairPal lists about $305-$448. Worn ball joints or bushings found during the check cost extra.

items.t: Hard thud when the transmission downshifts
items.job: Replace transmission control unit or transmission
items.note: One owner was quoted $1,800 for the control unit and $6,200 for both at Lexus; a used transmission installed independently cost $1,300.

items.t: Throttle body fault puts car in limp mode
items.job: Inspect or replace throttle body under campaign 3LF
items.note: Free under Lexus campaign 3LF. If done outside the campaign, it is an expensive repair; ask for a written quote.

items.t: Rough idle when stopped in Drive
items.job: Diagnose rough idle and apply bulletin 01304
items.note: Diagnosis cost only. Worn engine mounts, if found, add about $300-$350.

items.job: Diagnose trunk lock and latch circuit
items.note: Diagnosis cost; a new latch or actuator adds parts.

items.t: Musty or sour smell from the A/C
items.job: A/C diagnosis, cabin filter and evaporator cleaning
items.note: RepairPal lists about $153-$224 for A/C diagnosis on the SC 430.
RepairPal lists about $99-$168 depending on year. A tensioner costs extra.

items.job: Replace front control arms with new bushings
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,237-$1,518 for the SC 430, plus an alignment. Pressing in new bushings alone costs less.
RepairPal lists about $294-$351 per mount on the SC 430.
About $290 per assembly on SC 300/400 per owners; polishing a hazy lens costs far less.

items.t: Mark Levinson stereo cuts out or volume jumps
items.note: Diagnosis cost; a rebuilt amplifier or new speakers add parts.

items.t: Power steering pump leaks onto the alternator
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $800-$1,045 for an SC 400. A reseal or rebuild costs less; add an alternator if it was soaked.

items.t: Gauge needles or climate and radio displays go dark
items.job: Replace backlight bulbs or rebuild gauge cluster
items.note: Bulbs are about $7 each; a cluster rebuild by a specialist costs more.
About $400 per hinge at a dealer, per owners.

items.t: Water pump leak and timing belt due
items.job: Replace timing belt and water pump
items.note: RepairPal lists about $940-$1,300 for the belt alone and $1,070-$1,340 for the water pump; doing both together saves labor.

items.t: Engine computer capacitors leak, causing stalling
items.note: Diagnosis cost; a rebuilt or replacement engine computer adds parts.
